$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFQT (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: Grass strip reserved for gliders during their activity.
Simultaneous use of both grass strip and main RWY 04- 22 is prohibited.
ULM activity: reserved to ACFT equipped with radio and sqwak, affiliated to based organisations having signed an agreement with CA services.
Usable declared distances: TORA,TODA, ASDA and LDA RWY 22 reduced due to the infrangible shelter of LOC 22 at 180 m from RWY end.
Heavy IFR training activity.
On arrival and on transit, radio contact recommended with MERVILLE TWR at least 5 min before entering the CTR.
Low height traffic patterns: only with ATS clearance and at 300 ft AAL MNM.
Night training patterns prohibited outside ATC SKED except AD operator authorization on standard circuit and at a MNM height of 1500 ft.
Departure 04: climb in the axis 036°, do not turn before having overtaken the factory in the north east sector.
Departure 04 with turn before factory: only on ATS clearance, turn right and follow trajectory south of railway.
Preferred QFU: 216°, due to ILS procedure.
Consignes particulières / Special instructions PCL outside ATS SKED upon PPR from AD operator.
PCL inactive 0000-0500 (SUM: -1 HR).
Activation with PPR 48 HR.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with a radar display (see AD 1.0).
AEM NR 8253: see AIP ENR 5.5.
Aerobatics NR 6015: see AIP ENR 5.5.
PJE NR 241: see AIP ENR 5.5.
Pyrotechnic inoperative.
Radiocommunication failure: Transit: Before ATC clearance, pass round of the CTR.
After ATC clearance, comply with the latest clearance received.
ARR/DEP: Join the nearest compulsory WPT and turn back to AD by the mandatory route, proceed overhead higher than the circuit and join published downwind leg.
Adhere to possible visual signals.
